title: Yellowstone's Deadliest Animal Is a 2,000-Pound Bison That Runs 35 mph

scenes.text: Yellowstone's most dangerous animal isn't a bear.
It's a bison. Males can weigh up to 2,000 pounds.
And they can run 35 miles an hour, about three times faster than you.
Bison have injured more people in the park than any other animal.
The rule is to stay more than 25 yards away. That's about two bus lengths.
They look slow. They are not.

description:
Yellowstone's most dangerous animal isn't a bear, it's the bison.
Males can weigh up to 2,000 pounds, run about 35 miles an hour, and have injured more people in the park than any other animal. Visitors must stay more than 25 yards away.
Would you have guessed a bison? Comment below.
first_comment: Rangers say 25 yards for bison, and 100 yards for bears and wolves. Did you know the distances are different?
